candidates.sample_origin: Ovarian follicles of untreated and HCG-treated Japanese yellowtail broodstock (Japan; farm/site not stated in abstract). Heliyon 2020: tertiary-yolk-stage ovary fragments of yellowtail, Japan.
candidates.chembl: ChEMBL CHEMBL274826 (max_phase -1, not approved). Team filters were applied (pChEMBL present, relation '=', assay type B/F, data_validity none or Manually validated, not potential_duplicate). Protein targets with filtered cohort >= 30: CHEMBL1978 aromatase IC50 n=2, median 6.26, cohort 3097 (docs CHEMBL1127575, CHEMBL5241054); CHEMBL1978 aromatase Ki n=2, median 7.58, cohort 590 (CHEMBL1127575, CHEMBL3751755); CHEMBL3072 androgen receptor (rat) IC50 n=2, median 6.54, cohort 528 (CHEMBL1123274, CHEMBL1141069); CHEMBL4234 HSD17B3 IC50 n=3, median 6.19, cohort 239 (CHEMBL1133052, CHEMBL1135571); CHEMBL6152 alpha-synuclein IC50 4.07, cohort 180 (CHEMBL4699438); CHEMBL3305 SHBG Kd 7.46, cohort 91 (CHEMBL1142400); CHEMBL2421 CBG Ki 5.76, cohort 31 (CHEMBL1148457). Pathogen: CHEMBL364 P. falciparum IC50 5.00, cohort 46757 (CHEMBL1255382). qHTS only (CHEMBL1201862): ALDH1A1 Potency 7.90 (cohort 75926), SMN Potency median 6.85 (33697), NPSR Potency 6.6 (15388), ROR-gamma 5.0 (89091), BLM 3.6 (3397), and others. Excluded target types: UNCHECKED CHEMBL612545, NON-MOLECULAR CHEMBL3879801. Unfiltered totals: aromatase IC50 4413, Ki 653, AR IC50 1460, HSD17B3 301, SHBG Kd 92, CBG Ki 31. Link DOIs 2 and ChEMBL docs >= 2 for several groups, so the BBVI independence count min(link, doc) = 2 if accepted.
why: Ubiquity: endogenous vertebrate sex-steroid intermediate. It is not in the enumerated exclusion list, and Wikidata P703 has only 5 taxa (below the Tukey fence 31), but the link-review 'ubiquitous_metabolite' class (used for agmatine, DHA, formaldehyde) would likely apply. Team-lead decision.

Origin is an in vitro product: yellowtail ovarian follicles were incubated with exogenous radiolabelled precursors ([3H]pregnenolone, [3H]17-hydroxyprogesterone, [14C]androstenedione) and the products were identified by TLC plus recrystallization to constant specific activity, with no NMR/MS. In the second link (Heliyon 2020), progesterone or 17-OHP was added and androstenedione was measured by time-resolved fluoroimmunoassay, which is not a structural identification.
Rahman 2001 was seen as abstract only (Crossref; Wiley paywall).

Several of the highest pChEMBL values are qHTS Potency from PubChem BioAssay (CHEMBL1201862), which the team flagged as non-confirmatory. The non-qHTS protein-target groups are listed in activity_source.
Percentile and MBPI were not computed here: no estimation; the build script must do it.

why: The only pChEMBL group is target CHEMBL612558 'ADMET' (Kd for binding to alpha-1-acid glycoprotein, n=4, median 4.95, raw cohort 239). ADMET target types are excluded by the stratum layer rule, so no eligible cohort remains.

Structure mapping: the PubChem name 'biliverdin' gives 3 CIDs (5280353, 5353439, 251). The ChEMBL record CHEMBL455477 uses another tautomer InChIKey (QBUVFDKTZJNUPP-BBROENKCSA-N) that PubChem does not hold, so it is not exactly one CID.
Ubiquitous vertebrate heme catabolite.

Filtered groups, all qHTS CHEMBL1201862: tau Potency median 4.85 (cohort 94769), ALDH1A1 4.55 (75926), KDM4E 4.5 (39941), prelamin-A/C 4.75 (36672), cruzipain 4.4 (30568), caspase-1 4.6 (2960), caspase-7 4.7 (2316), and others. Unfiltered also has OATP1B1 IC50 5.88 (raw cohort 217) and OATP1B3 IC50 5.47 (125), both CHEMBL3039007.
why: Ubiquitous vertebrate heme catabolite, measured in diseased (jaundiced) fish tissue. Sakai 1990 states bilirubin IXalpha was detected only in red sea bream bile, not in yellowtail bile.
After the team activity filters, every pChEMBL group is qHTS Potency from CHEMBL1201862 (non-confirmatory). The OATP1B1/1B3 IC50/Ki records (doc CHEMBL3039007) drop out under the filters.
No ChEMBL record under any variant: InChIKey blocks SORWZIAILHWTAV, LKNJLIDYYPZTNI, KKEKGSQEQHXVPM and JDRVSYVCRZSWOK all return 0, and a name search returns 0.
PubChem CID 6438832 'Ditaurobilirubin' (disodium salt; parent CID 6913088) shows a C29 skeleton without the 4 methyl and 2 vinyl groups of bilirubin, so the structure and InChIKey are unreliable.

dead_ends: Tunaxanthin B (KNApSAcK C00022885 / COCONUT CNP0281543.4, the only database compound for this taxon): carotenoid (excluded class); PubChem CID 6384258; no ChEMBL record.
Taurine and cholesterol (Minato 1949), trimethylamine and TMAO, creatine, free amino acids: excluded classes (amino-acid amine, C1, amino acids, sterol).

Hypoxanthine (CHEMBL1427), inosine (CHEMBL1556), IMP, nucleotide-related compounds in heated or stored meat (IND607012863, IND608418319, 31635314): ubiquitous purine metabolites. Most of their ChEMBL groups are qHTS or UNCHECKED.
Anserine (CHEMBL448301: no pChEMBL) and carnosine (CHEMBL242948, max_phase 3: qHTS plus SLC15A2 Ki cohort 31): ubiquitous muscle dipeptides. No yellowtail paper names them in a title or abstract.

Taurocholic acid (CHEMBL224867: GPBAR1 EC50 5.30 cohort 1330; NTCP IC50 5.28 cohort 96; ASBT Ki 4.38 cohort 48): no yellowtail paper identifying it was found (Minato 1949 reports cholic acid after workup). Ubiquitous bile salt.
Selenoneine: the yellowtail study (Nippon Suisan Gakkaishi 79:863, 2013) injected it (administered); no ChEMBL record.
11-Ketotestosterone, 17,20beta-dihydroxy-5beta-pregnan-3-one: no ChEMBL record (the latter also has no PubChem name hit). Testosterone and 17beta-estradiol: approved drugs (max_phase 4).
17alpha-hydroxyprogesterone (CHEMBL1062) and pregnenolone: supplied as radiolabelled precursors in Rahman 2001, not identified as yellowtail products.

Volatiles and oxidation products: 2,3-butanedione, (E,E)-2,4-hexadienal, (E)-2-pentenal, 1-pentanol, 4-hydroxy-2-hexenal, aldehydes and alcohols (IND605890087, IND606275980, 35481592, 34143181, 24390795, 18776665): excluded oxidation or process products.
Contaminants: organohalogens, OH-PCBs, MeO-PBDEs/6-OH-BDE47 (21782210, diet or pollutant), butyltins (suisan 69:10), PFAS (32510380), mercury.
Microbial or diet-derived: Pseudoalteromonas nigrifaciens lipooligosaccharide (34822517), Pacific ciguatoxins (diet).
Vitamins and lipids: alpha-tocopherol, retinol, vitamin D (approved or very common), DHA/EPA/oleic acid (excluded fatty acids), squalene (36900601; very common).
Gangliosides of yellowtail intestine and brain (Shima 2006 J Fish Dis 29:249, 10.1111/j.1365-2761.2006.00703.x): a lipid class, not a single defined compound.
Metabolomics papers 34822451 (CE-TOFMS) and 31635314 (GC-MS): only TCA acids, amino acids, sugars, inosine and hypoxanthine.
Hybrid or extract papers (milt hydrolysate 36069409, fish ingredients HIF screen 32290307, mushroom-extract feeding IND44270340): extracts or diet.
Wikidata P703 for the species: 0. CMNPD: 0. NPAtlas: not applicable.
KoreaScience/KCI web search: no Korean compound-isolation paper for 방어.
Biliverdin and bilirubin fail the ChEMBL layer or qHTS rules (see candidates). Ditaurobilirubin and 17,20beta-P are not in ChEMBL.
